children: The London Metal Exchange said on Wednesday that it would roll out electronic options trading on LMEselect v10 from March 30 2027 with the market test environment available from October 19, 2026.
The move is part of the LME's plan to modernise the options market. The exchange is the world's oldest and largest market for industrial metals.
